Implemented type-safe window function helpers, frame specifications, and named `WINDOW` clause support across all supported dialects.

### Summary of Changes

- **Window Functions & Frame Helpers ([window.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts))**:
  - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L238-L240), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L242-L244), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L246-L248), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L250-L253), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L255-L257), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L259-L261).
  - **Offset / value-access helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L265-L293), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L295-L323), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L325-L329), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L331-L335), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L337-L343). Typed as nullable (`T | null`) by default, with [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L265-L293) and [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L295-L323) stripping `null` when a non-null `defaultValue` is provided.
  - **Window aggregates**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L347-L349), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L351-L353), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L355-L363), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L365-L373), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L375-L377).
  - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L85-L92), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L94-L101), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L27-L29), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L31-L33), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L35-L37), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L45-L51), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L53-L59).
  - **Builder**: [`WindowFunction`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/window.ts#L184-L204) with `.over(specOrName)` compiling inline specifications (`over (...)`) or named window references (`over "name"`).
  - Re-exported from [src/sql/functions/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sql/functions/index.ts) and the top-level package [src/index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/index.ts).

- **Select Query Builders & Dialects**:
  - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` method and `WINDOW` clause compilation prior to `ORDER BY` across PostgreSQL ([pg-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/query-builders/select.ts#L860-L878), [pg-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/pg-core/dialect.ts#L403-L439)), MySQL ([mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/query-builders/select.ts#L907-L925), [mysql-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/mysql-core/dialect.ts#L395-L420)), SQLite ([sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/query-builders/select.ts#L708-L726), [sqlite-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/sqlite-core/dialect.ts#L374-L380)), SingleStore ([singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/query-builders/select.ts#L780-L798), [singlestore-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/singlestore-core/dialect.ts#L374-L393)), and Gel ([gel-core/query-builders/select.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/query-builders/select.ts#L853-L871), [gel-core/dialect.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/src/gel-core/dialect.ts#L398-L434)).

- **Tests ([window.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-5hak8nw3/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts))**:
  - Added unit and type tests covering ranking, offset, aggregate helpers, frames, validation errors, and named windows across all dialects.
